ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, hairline borders, video frame outlines, pill button stroke — the only chromatic event in the UI

paper.$description: Paper — Soft icon strokes, subtle dividers, and low-emphasis decorative details. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ash.$description: Ash — Muted text in the cycling manifesto, list dividers, inactive link tone — desaturated gray stays quiet next to ink

magicuipro.$description: Single-family system: body text and micro-headlines both sit in the 18–24px range at medium weight, with weight 600 reserved for the active manifesto item and button labels. The tight -0.01em tracking and modest size range mean type never breaks 24px — the page treats every word as a label, not a headline.
